name: Article 5, § 2 – 8
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council establishing the Programme for agile and rapid defence innovation (AGILE)
part_text: 2. According to the European Commission, the Union and its Member States have mobilised more than EUR 90 billion in support of Ukraine’s military and defence capabilities. Despite this substantial commitment, the conflict continues to claim lives and a cessation of hostilities remains elusive, proving the utter futility of military escalation as a substitute for political solutions. Instead of establishing yet another instrument to funnel public money into the highly profitable military-industrial complex and entrenching a permanent war economy, public resources must be strictly redirected towards serious diplomatic efforts to secure a lasting peace, as well as addressing the real existential threats to European citizens: the dismantling of public healthcare, the chronic underfunding of education, the erosion of decent work, and the unbearable energy costs crushing households and small businesses.
